subject: Demo recap + proposed trial: evaluation checklist and owners
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Emma King <emma.king@silverline.com>, Rajesh Patel <rajesh.patel@silverline.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 6 Sep 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Demo recap + proposed trial: evaluation checklist and owners

Hi Emma / Rajesh —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our side and a proposed trial (POC) plan so we can lock timelines and owners. I tried to keep this concise so your team can share internally.

Summary of what we heard on the call
- Goal: Reduce time-to-insight across clinical document ingestion (extraction + entity resolution) and improve retrieval relevance for clinician search.
- Primary success measures you mentioned: extraction accuracy on 3 sample document types, retrieval precision for top-5 results, and no PII leakage in logs/audits.

Proposed POC (4-week, scoped):
Week 0 (pre-kickoff, doc handoff): share sample datasets & access, finalize success test set (we included a checklist).
Week 1: baseline run on your sample set + small config changes; measure extraction accuracy and latency.
Week 2: iterate on prompt/templates and retrieval tuning; validate top-5 precision and recall.
Week 3: run security audit checklist + prefix caching validation (throughput).
Week 4: acceptance run + final results review and postmortem.

Target success criteria (proposal):
- Extraction F1 >= 0.90 on the signed-off sample set
- Top-5 retrieval precision >= 0.85 on clinician queries
- 99th percentile per-turn latency < 350 ms for single-document queries in your dev environment
- No PII retained in logs; audit trail available for all requests

Owners (proposed):
- Silverline: Rajesh (technical lead), Emma (project sponsor / clinical lead)
- Redwood: Soojin (eng & program lead), Ben (deal owner), Marissa (solutions / implementation)

Attachments: silverline-poc-checklist.xlsx (checklist + test set schema), redwood-poc-proposal.pdf (detailed timeline & deliverables). Also linking the checklist here: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1a2b3c4d5e_poc-checklist

Immediate next steps (please):
1) Can you confirm decision-maker(s) for final acceptance and legal contact for the order form?
2) Confirm that the sample datasets we discussed are ok to share to the secure folder by EOD Wed (9/8).
3) If the plan looks good, propose kickoff week — we’re currently targeting the week of Sep 13 but can move if you prefer.

If you want, Ben and I can prepare a 20-minute kickoff agenda and a short acceptance rubric doc for your legal team.

Thanks —
Sooj

--

Subject: Re: Demo recap + proposed trial: evaluation checklist and owners

Sooj — thanks for the clear recap and the checklist. Quick notes from our side:

- The proposed success metrics capture the right signals. One add: we need to measure redaction/PII masking accuracy on the same sample set (target >= 0.98 true negatives for redacted fields).
- Our security team asked if you can share the data handling and retention section in a short one-pager (we prefer something 1–2 pages we can circulate).
- We’d like to shift the kickoff one week later to the week of Sep 20 to allow our IT to provision the secure S3 bucket and run an initial access review.

CC'ing security@silverline.com so they can flag any blocking items early. Rajesh — can you confirm the sample files will be ready by Sep 10?

Also, we prefer Redwood to run the initial baseline on a redacted stub dataset first (non-production) and then on the full sample after access is confirmed.

Thanks —
Emma
